California Governor Candidates Set to Debate

California gubernatorial candidates Xavier Becerra and Gavin Newsom are scheduled to participate in a debate. The debate is set to occur days before voters receive their mail-in ballots. Becerra has previously advocated for the death penalty but stated he would extend a moratorium if elected governor. The coverage does not specify the exact date or location of the debate.
